text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Spain agrees to convert $50 million, part of Morocco's debt, into private investments.
- The United Nations Security Council must demand the application of the self-determination referendum in Western Sahara not to lose credibility.
- Interior, transport and public works ministries organise two-day seminar starting Dec 5 on road security, entitled "For safer streets and roads".
- Algerian Interior Minister Mustapha Ben Mansour's visit to Morocco may be a sign of an easing of tension between the two countries.
- Marrakesh to host Euro-Mediterranean meeting of businessmen on Dec 5.
- Despite new law splitting telecommunications network, the state will keep control through an agency.
